name: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: full job set selected
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: echo 'SELECTED plan-test linux pack cub macos pack-macos tier'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
      - name: local gate wiring proof
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: python3 -I ci/local-gate-test.py
      - name: local evidence gate
        if: ${{ !(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix')) }}
        run: echo 'Local gauntlet evidence is the gate; request ci or full-matrix for CI.'

ci.yml.plan-test:
# tier: pr
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'plan-test')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python3 -I ci/tiers-test.py
      - run: python3 -I ci/memgate-test.py
      - run: python3 -I ci/perf-test.py
      - run: python3 -I ci/check-test.py
ci.yml.linux:
# tier: pr
    name: linux x86-64 (fmt, tests, builds, sound goldens and latency, selftest)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'linux')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-linux-${{ hashFiles('wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: the Linux leg, in the container
        env:
          LAIR_ENGINE: docker
        run: tools/in-container tools/check-linux
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: linux-evidence
          path: |
            target/test.log
            target/sound
ci.yml.pack:
# tier: pr
    name: pack on this engine (goldens, pty rows in the container)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'pack')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    env:
      # The engine under test is never the one pack pins: every engine tool
      # in this job says so loudly instead of refusing (tools/lib-root.sh).
      LAIR_UNPINNED: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: pack, at the first ref of ci/games.conf that exists
        run: ci/stage-game pack game
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: game/.wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-linux-${{ hashFiles('wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: game/.lair/tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: pack's Linux leg on the engine under test
        env:
          LAIR_ENGINE: docker
        run: game/.lair/tools/in-container .lair/tools/check-linux
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: pack-evidence
          path: |
            game/target/goldens
            game/target/pty
            game/target/test.log
ci.yml.cub:
# tier: pr
    name: cub on this engine (complete Linux suite)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'cub')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    env:
      LAIR_UNPINNED: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: cub trunk on the engine under test
        run: ci/stage-game cub game
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: game/.wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-linux-${{ hashFiles('wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: game/.lair/tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: cub's complete Linux suite, including both gameplay backends
        env:
          LAIR_ENGINE: docker
        run: game/.lair/tools/in-container tools/check-linux
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: cub-evidence
          path: |
            game/target/goldens
            game/target/pty
            game/target/test.log
ci.yml.macos:
name: macOS arm64 (the engine's build, tests, selftest)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'macos')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-macos-${{ hashFiles('wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: tools/fetch-toolchain
      # RULES section 4's memory gate is nomad's (the maintainer's Mac); the
      # runner's free-memory figure means nothing for it (tools/lib-mem.sh).
      - name: fmt, the tests, both builds, the selftest
        env:
          LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
        run: tools/check
ci.yml.pack-macos:
name: pack on this engine (macOS goldens and pty rows)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'pack-macos')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    env:
      LAIR_UNPINNED: '1'
      LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: pack trunk on the engine under test
        run: ci/stage-game pack game
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: game/.wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-macos-${{ hashFiles('wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: game/.lair/tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: fmt, tests, both builds, selftest, goldens and every pty row
        run: game/.lair/tools/check
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: pack-macos-evidence
          path: |
            game/target/goldens
            game/target/pty
            game/target/test.log
ci.yml.tier:
name: tier ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tier || 'unplanned' }}
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs:
      - plan
      - plan-test
      - linux
      - pack
      - cub
      - macos
      - pack-macos
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 ci/tiers.py verdict
